Package com.example.ecolums

Class ActivityLog

java.lang.Object
com.example.ecolums.ActivityLog
public class ActivityLog extends Object
Manages the creation, retrieval, editing, and deletion of a user's daily sustainability activity log entries, and converts raw inputs into CO2 equivalents using CalculationMetric factors.

Responsibilities (from CRC card):

  • Capture transport, energy, and waste data inputs.
  • Convert raw activity data into CO2 (carbon equivalents).
  • Provide data for personal visualizations.

Collaborators: User, ProgressTracker.

Each log entry is stored as a document under users/{userId}/activityLogs/{logId} in Firestore.

Outstanding issues: Firestore real-time listener for the daily-log list view has not been wired to the UI yet.

  • Method Details

    • convertToCO2

      public void convertToCO2(Map<String,CalculationMetric> metrics)
      Converts the raw input fields of this log entry into a CO2 equivalent (kg) by looking up the relevant CalculationMetric from Firestore.

      For transport: co2EquivalentKg = distanceKm × factor. For energy: co2EquivalentKg = energyKwh × factor. For waste: factor depends on wasteType.

      After computing, calls calculatePoints() to set pointsEarned.

      Parameters:
      metrics - Map of metricKey → CalculationMetric, pre-fetched to avoid an extra Firestore read per log.

    • calculatePoints

      public void calculatePoints()
      Derives green points from co2EquivalentKg.

      Current rule: 10 points per kg of CO2 equivalent saved. Negative CO2 (e.g. car travel) yields 0 points.

    • submitLog

      public void submitLog(User.OnCompleteCallback callback)
      Saves this log entry as a new Firestore document under users/{userId}/activityLogs/.

      On success, notifies ProgressTracker to re-aggregate the user's totals and award any newly unlocked badges.

      Parameters:
      callback - Invoked with true on success.

    • editLog

      public void editLog(User.OnCompleteCallback callback)
      Updates an existing log entry in Firestore with the current field values.

      Only entries from the current day may be edited.

      Parameters:
      callback - Invoked with true on success.

    • deleteLog

      public void deleteLog(User.OnCompleteCallback callback)
      Deletes this log entry from Firestore.

      On success, triggers a recalculation of the user's total points via ProgressTracker.

      Parameters:
      callback - Invoked with true on success.

    • getLogsForUser

      public static void getLogsForUser(String targetUserId, com.google.firebase.Timestamp from, com.google.firebase.Timestamp to, ActivityLog.OnLogsLoadedCallback callback)
      Fetches all log entries for the specified user within a date range.

      Results are ordered by date descending (most recent first).

      Parameters:
      targetUserId - UID of the user whose logs to fetch.
      from - Start of the date range (inclusive).
      to - End of the date range (inclusive).
      callback - Receives the list of matching log entries.

    • getTodaysLogs

      public static void getTodaysLogs(String targetUserId, ActivityLog.OnLogsLoadedCallback callback)
      Fetches today's log entries for the specified user, used to populate the "Daily History" view and enforce the daily-edit window.
      Parameters:
      targetUserId - UID of the user.
      callback - Receives today's log entries.
